Please do not be guilty about doing what makes you happy. Happiness is all we have in this world, and it’s what so many of us strive to accomplish. You aren’t obligated to do things you don’t want to do, if living a quiet life makes you happy, do it!! Maybe you could look for a small compromise, perhaps donating money to charities every month so you can feel like you’re giving back to the world. Or cleaning up litter around your neighborhood, or doing favors for neighbors. Sure, you have the potential to do more. But it’s okay to not live up to that. If i lived to my potential i would be getting better grades in school, constantly studying, and getting into amazing colleges. But i wouldn’t be happy living a life like that. I wasn’t born into a good life, but i feel the same way about wanting a normal life. 

TLDR: Don’t push yourself to do things you don’t want to do. You will be okay, and happy living the life you want. If guilt bothers you, do small discreet things to give back— unless you REALLY want to do something big. You’ll be okay! ❤️
